series.title: Billionaire CEO vs Mafia
series.description: A powerful billionaire CEO finds himself entangled in a dangerous war against the mafia when a deal goes wrong. Caught between the corporate world and the criminal underworld, he must outsmart ruthless enemies to protect everything he built.

series.title: Dear Husband I Upgraded to a CEO
series.description: After being humiliated and abandoned by her wealthy husband, a determined woman rises from nothing to become the CEO of a rival company. Now she's back — not for love, but for revenge.

series.title: I Adopted My Stolen Baby
series.description: A heartbroken mother discovers that the baby she adopted is actually her own biological child who was stolen at birth. As she unravels the dark conspiracy behind the adoption, she must fight to reclaim her child and expose the truth.

series.title: Marry Me By Christmas
series.description: A career-driven woman makes a desperate pact to find a husband before Christmas to satisfy her family's expectations. But when a charming stranger enters her life, the lines between fake romance and real feelings begin to blur.

series.title: Mrs. CEO Strictly Unprofessional
series.description: A no-nonsense female CEO known for her iron discipline finds her perfectly controlled world turned upside down when a carefree new employee challenges every rule she's ever set — including the ones around her heart.

series.title: My Knockout Fake Husband
series.description: To escape an arranged marriage, a young woman hires a down-on-his-luck boxer to pose as her husband. But when real punches — and real feelings — start flying, keeping up the act becomes the hardest fight of all.

series.title: Destined For My Billionaire Soulmate
series.description: A small-town girl's life changes forever when a chance encounter with a mysterious billionaire reveals a connection that transcends wealth and status. But fate has more twists in store than either of them imagined.

series.title: Keep Your Ring I'm President Now
series.description: After being left at the altar by her fiancé, a humiliated woman channels her heartbreak into ambition and rises through the political ranks to become the youngest female president. When her ex comes crawling back, she has one message: keep your ring.

series.title: Billionaire CEO vs Mafia Season 2
series.description: Kaan Erdoğan thought the war was over, but a new threat rises from the ashes of the old mafia empire. With new allies and deadlier enemies, the stakes have never been higher.

series.title: Dear Husband I Upgraded to a CEO Season 2
series.description: Asya thought her revenge was complete, but a corporate conspiracy threatens everything she built. Now she must fight not just her ex-husband, but a shadowy board of directors who want her gone.

series.title: I Adopted My Stolen Baby Season 2
series.description: Just when Nisan thought the nightmare was over, new evidence surfaces that the conspiracy behind the baby theft runs much deeper than anyone imagined. A powerful syndicate is involved, and Nisan must risk everything to bring them down.

series.title: Destined For My Billionaire Soulmate Season 2
series.description: Emma and Ethan's love is tested when a rival family threatens to destroy the Blackwell empire. With secrets from the past resurfacing, they must fight together or lose everything — including each other.
